# Lickety Split (G4)

Lickety Split is the quiet young Ponyville earth-pony colt whom Spike approaches while he is bouncing a ball in *Secret of My Excess*. When Spike announces that it is his birthday, the colt hands over the ball—a small act of generosity that also helps start Spike's escalating gift collecting. Spike calls him **“Lickety Split”** aloud, so this G4 name is spoken in the show, not merely a fan invention ([episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Secret_of_My_Excess)).

**Recognize him:** muted tan-brown coat, almost white/cream mane and tail, dark teal-blue eyes, and a cutie mark showing ice cream in a bowl ([G4 foal catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals?page=1)). His pale hair and dessert cutie mark are more distinctive than his brief screen time.

**Name and continuity:** Collectors also write *Lickety-Split* or *Lickity Split*. The name has a longer history: G1 has an adult Lickety-Split and Baby Lickety-Split, while G3 has a differently designed Lickity Split. Those are other-generation characters, **not** this colt's confirmed aliases or secret identities ([recycled-name history](https://mylittlewiki.org/wiki/Recycled_Names)).

**Speaking status:** No identifiable spoken lines from the G4 colt; Spike says his name, and the ball-bouncing scene supplies no reply. No verified G4 voice actor. Do not transfer the G1 mare's voice credit to him.

**Appearances:** *Secret of My Excess* (S2E10), where he gives Spike his ball, and *The Fault in Our Cutie Marks* (S6E19), where he is identifiable among the Ponyville crowd during Gabby's baseball sequence. His later role is a silent background appearance, not a separate character arc.

## Important moments

1. **Spike recognizes him by name — “Secret of My Excess” (S2E10).** Spike greets the ball-playing colt as Lickety Split, establishing his name in televised dialogue. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WuftAywZNRo) (scene timestamp unavailable; not independently verified against this upload).
2. **A birthday ball for Spike — “Secret of My Excess” (S2E10).** Lickety Split silently lets Spike take his ball after hearing it is his birthday; the innocent kindness becomes another step in Spike's growing obsession with gifts. Same episode and scene; timestamp unavailable.

For his later, non-speaking baseball-crowd appearance, see the [official full episode of “The Fault in Our Cutie Marks” (S6E19)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IecaL6I3pGA); scene timestamp unavailable.
